content_sections.title: Earlier past
content_sections.body_text: Use the past perfect for an earlier event: By the time we arrived, the film had started. Then continue the story in order.

content_sections.title: Link common words
content_sections.body_text: In connected speech, some small words are weaker. Keep the main message clear while you tell the sequence.
